title: A turn failure's Ambiguous settlement retires a receipted head before abandoning its pending Engram dispatch, clearing the successor's prepared evaluate
outcome: A turn failure's Ambiguous settlement retires a receipted head before abandoning its pending Engram dispatch, clearing the successor's prepared evaluate
acceptance: In fail_turn_if_runtime_matches_and_report (src/turn_lifecycle.rs), abandoning the pending Engram dispatch of a receipted, Engram-retained head no longer compares its fingerprint against the successor that the Ambiguous retirement (retire_queued_prompt) moved to the front: the dispatch is detached for its own head before, or independently of, the receipt's retirement, or abandon_engram_pending_dispatch leaves the front alone when the head it was captured for is gone. Ambiguous still wins over a removal's Rejected.
A test with a queued successor holding a prepared engram_evaluate shows the successor's evaluation survives the failed turn.
